about: THEMAQUEEN is a Korean beauty-device manufacturer founded in 2014. Its official website states that it supplies OEM products to Korean and overseas cosmetics brands and also operates its own brand.

The company’s official websites state that products are made in Korea using company-owned moulds and that its designs are patent-protected. Teranova verifies the applicable manufacturing, technical and IP documents separately for each B2B project.
